test_title: SSC Stenographer 2024 Official Paper (Held On: 10 Dec, 2024 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: R, S, T, U, V and W are sitting around a circular table facing the centre (but not necessarily in the same order). R sit second to the left of V. Only one person sits between R and S. Only two persons sit between S and W. T is not an immediate neighbour of R. Who sits second to the left of U?
solution:
**Given: **R, S, T, U, V and W are sitting around a circular table facing the centre.

1) R sit second to the left of V.

2) Only one person sits between R and S.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/8a80d77459aec237bdee3fd08ef472d71e99000def1eef0eb308ee55a2759817.png] 

3) Only two persons sit between S and W.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/eec4bf021c8f63755317c112d73fbf5f889114a31ed8b5a6a6b86ff07de55e05.png] 

4) T is not an immediate neighbour of R.

After positioning T only one position is left which will be occupied by the only person left i.e. U.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0a9dd92756aac021d6d62f1bb599378154672d8e9fb3929d601c7ee3cc77fcbb.png] 

Thus, according to the final arrangement, T sits second to the left of U.

Hence, **"Option 4"** is the correct answer.
